blocks.text: i. Sulphuric acid khud apne aap ionise hota hai (self-ionization ya autoprotolysis): ek H₂SO₄ molecule doosre ko proton deta hai.

Is ka equilibrium constant pani ke equilibrium constant se zyada hai, is liye H₂SO₄ ko non-aqueous protic solvent (pani ke ilawa aisa solvent jo proton de sakta hai) ke taur par istemal kiya ja sakta hai.
Sulphuric acid strong acid hai, jaisa is ki pKa1 qeemat batati hai:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki is equation mein baen taraf H₂O nahi likha, is liye woh balanced nahi. Proton pani ko milta hai aur H₃O⁺ banta hai: H₂SO₄ + H₂O ⇌ H₃O⁺ + HSO₄⁻.
Lekin hydrogensulfate (HSO₄¹⁻) kahin kamzor acid hai, kyun ke is ki pKa2 qeemat positive hai:

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: pKa jitna chhota (ya negative) ho, acid utna strong. pKa1 = –2 (strong), pKa2 = 1.92 (kamzor). Is liye H₂SO₄ ka pehla proton aasani se nikalta hai, doosra mushkil se.
ii. Concentrated sulphuric acid taqatwar dehydrating agent (pani nikalne wala) hai: yeh sucrose (cheeni), starch, lakri aur kaghaz se pani nikal leta hai aur carbon, bhaap aur garmi bachti hai.

blocks.title: Dilchasp maloomat (Interesting Information)
blocks.text: Laboratory ka ek mashhoor tajurba (demonstration) cheeni ki dehydration hai: kaala, masaam-daar (porous) carbon ka dher 'carbon snake' (saanp) ki tarah bartan se bahar nikalta hai.
Yeh ethyl alcohol ko bhi, halaat ke mutabiq, ethene ya ethoxyethane mein badal deta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne ethene ko C₂H₄(s) (solid) likha hai. Ethene gas hai: C₂H₄(g).
iii. Jab sulphuric acid sodium chloride se react karta hai to hydrochloric acid (HCl) gas banti hai:

iv. Metals ke saath sulphuric acid ka reaction metal, acid ki concentration aur temperature par munhasir hai. Electrochemical series mein hydrogen se oopar wali metals, jaise Fe, Al, Zn, Mn, Ni aur Mg, dilute sulphuric acid se seedha react kar ke hydrogen gas aur metal sulfates banati hain. Lekin thande concentrated H₂SO₄ ke saath yeh SO₂ chhorti hain aur sulfates banati hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki equation mein product Fe²⁺ likha hai, halanke reaction zinc ka hai, aur baen taraf sirf ek H₂SO₄ hai, jis se equation balanced nahi. Sahi: Zn + 2H₂SO₄ → SO₂ + Zn²⁺ + SO₄²⁻ + 2H₂O.

v. Cu, Ag aur Hg jaisi metals garam concentrated H₂SO₄ se react kar ke metal sulfates banati hain. Sulphuric acid ko aam taur par oxidising agent nahi samjha jata, kyun ke SO₄²⁻ anion bohat stable hai aur sirf thora oxidising hai. Lekin garam concentrated sulphuric acid darmiyane darje ka taqatwar oxidising agent hai, kyun ke (1) temperature zyada hai, (2) protons (H⁺) ki concentration zyada hai, aur (3) nascent (taaza bani) oxygen banti hai. Garam concentrated sulphuric acid copper ko is tarah oxidise karta hai:

blocks.prompt: a) Concentrated H₂SO₄ ke starch aur oxalic acid ke saath dehydration reactions likhein.
blocks.explanation: Starch: (C₆H₁₀O₅)ₙ → 6nC + 5nH₂O (conc. H₂SO₄ pani nikal leta hai, carbon bachta hai). Oxalic acid: H₂C₂O₄ → CO + CO₂ + H₂O (conc. H₂SO₄ ke saath).

blocks.prompt: b) Conc. H₂SO₄ NaCl se kaise react karta hai? Is reaction ki ahmiyat kya hai?
blocks.explanation: NaCl + H₂SO₄ → NaHSO₄ + HCl. Is se laboratory mein HCl gas banai jati hai (aur salt analysis mein chloride ki pehchan hoti hai); kam volatile acid (H₂SO₄) zyada volatile acid (HCl) ko us ke salt se nikal deta hai.

blocks.prompt: c) Thande aur garam sulphuric acid ki oxidising taqat mein kya farq hai?
blocks.explanation: Thanda (ya dilute) acid sirf kamzor oxidiser hai kyun ke SO₄²⁻ stable hai; yeh zyada tar hydrogen se oopar wali metals se react kar ke H₂ deta hai. Garam concentrated acid zyada temperature, zyada H⁺ aur nascent oxygen ki wajah se darmiyana taqatwar oxidiser hai; yeh Cu, Ag aur Hg ko bhi oxidise karta hai aur khud SO₂ mein reduce hota hai.

items: Autoprotolysis: K = 2.7 × 10⁻⁴ (pani se zyada), non-aqueous protic solvent.
Strong acid: pKa1 = –2; HSO₄⁻ kamzor, pKa2 = 1.92.
Dehydrating agent: cheeni (carbon snake), ethanol → ethene; NaCl se HCl gas.
Dilute acid + active metal → H₂; garam conc. acid Cu, Ag, Hg ko oxidise kar ke SO₂ deta hai.
